channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Currículo' de Flávio vai à TV e viraliza nas redes na campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign released a video attacking Flávio Bolsonaro's record, which trended on social media with 10 million views. The ad will remain on TV until tomorrow per the PT campaign's directive.

item.title: Mulher na urna, homem no poder
item.description: The text emphasizes the role of women in the 2026 electoral decision, contrasting female presence at the polls with male dominance in the exercise of power. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are mentioned as candidates whose outcome depends on the female vote.

item.title: Projeto reforça validade de mensagens compartilhadas como prova
item.description: Bill 3349/26 amends the Criminal Procedure Code to allow messaging app conversations to be used as evidence when voluntarily shared by one participant, excluding content obtained through illegal means. The proposal aims to align legislation with technological evolution and TSE jurisprudence, citing a 2024 vote-buying case. The bill has expedited processing and requires approval by both the Chamber and Senate.

item.title: Depois de agradecer a Trump, Flávio mente no JN e empurra culpa a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro lied on Journal Nacional about Trump tariffs, hiding that his family supported and publicly thanked the US president. The caucus debunked the farce, recalling that while brother Eduardo celebrated, Brazil is the one paying. The senator tried to blame Lula, but only further evidenced putting family interests above the country.

item.title: Campanha presidencial errática de Zema ameaça até o futuro do partido Novo
item.description: Romeu Zema's (Novo) presidential campaign has been marked by solitary appearances and low support, with around 3% of voting intentions, according to Datafolha. His public appearances at fairs and events highlight criticism of the government and fiscal adjustment proposals, but fail to mobilize voters or attract allies.

item.title: 7 candidatos à Presidência recebem segurança da PF nas eleições
item.description: Seven of the thirteen presidential candidates accepted Federal Police protection during the electoral campaign, with the operation costing R$ 95 million. Flávio Bolsonaro, Rui Costa Pimenta, and Hertz Dias rejected the protection due to distrust in the PF or because they consider the risk low. The PF offers mandatory institutional protection to all candidates, even if some choose not to accept it.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio têm vantagem sobre lulistas nos maiores estados e DF
item.description: Candidates aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) lead polls in four of the ten largest states and in the Federal District, while only Eduardo Paes (PSD) represents the Lula (PT) wing among frontrunners. In three major states the race is tied, and in two others the leading candidates do not endorse either national leader. This scenario reflects a fragmentation of the electorate and partisan support across the country's main political poles.

item.title: A primeira pesquisa Datafolha para presidente após as entrevistas dos candidatos à TV Globo
item.description: Datafolha will release next Thursday the first poll on the presidential race after TV Globo's candidate interviews, surveying 2,004 voters at a cost of R$307,600. This will be the second survey since the start of the campaign on August 16 and the first commissioned by the Globo group. The poll will also measure the impact of free electoral time, which began on Saturday.

item.title: Uma década do impeachment: dez políticos que optaram por saída de Dilma têm apoio de Lula na eleição
item.description: Ten politicians who backed Dilma Rousseff's impeachment in 2016 now sit on Lula's coalition ballots for the 2026 elections, reflecting shifts in Brazil's political landscape. Figures such as Simone Tebet, Renan Calheiros, and Pedro Paulo, once opponents of the PT, currently align with the party in races for state governments and Senate seats. The scenario underscores how recent history has been reframed following the 2022 presidential race and Lula's return to power.

item.title: Haddad aposta em campanha nas ruas, e Tarcísio, nas redes e eventos fechados
item.description: Haddad and Tarcísio launch campaigns with opposing strategies: while the former focuses on street walks and direct engagement, the latter relies on closed events, social media, and traditional advertising. Senate candidates mirror ideological divides, highlighting the polarized electoral landscape.

item.title: Da CLT ao aplicativo: pesquisa inédita aponta as prioridades do eleitor diante das mudanças no trabalho
item.description: A GLOBO survey reveals that 21.3% of Brazilians prioritize job stability,followed by autonomy (16.2%) and flexible schedules (13.1%). The experience ofLeandro Alves, an app delivery driver, illustrates the search for balancbetween autonomy and labor rights in the post-pandemic era. This issue is likely tostand out in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Senado Verifica reforça atuação contra desinformação nas eleições
item.description: Senado Verifica strengthens its efforts against misinformation in the 2026 elections, combating manipulated videos, cloned audios, and false allegations. Through a partnership with TSE, it provides fact-checking services, special assistance on election day, and media education to prepare citizens against manipulation. The main concern is the misuse of artificial intelligence to mislead voters.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao governo do DF deste domingo (30/8)
item.description: The DF gubernatorial candidates maintained an intensive campaign schedule on Sunday (30/8), with activities including walks, parades, cultural events and meetings with supporters. The main actions took place in areas such as Brasília, Taguatinga, Vicente Pires and Cidade Estrutural.

item.title: Confira as agendas dos candidatos à Presidência neste domingo (30/8)
item.description: Presidential candidates carry out campaign activities nationwide on Sunday with diverse schedules including interviews, public events, and meetings. Some have suspended or unreported agendas.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP neste domingo (30/8)
item.description: On Sunday (August 30), the seven candidates for governor of São Paulo continue their campaign schedules for the 2026 elections. Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead the polls, with the incumbent governor attending an event in Campo Grande and Haddad recording his program. Other candidates also hold public activities and campaign events in the city.

item.title: Fluminense encara o Athletico no Brasileirão com volta de Guga e desfalque de Hércules
item.description: Fluminense faces Athletico-PR in the 25th round of the Brazilian Championship with Guga returning and Hércules out. Coach Marcões likely keeps the lineup with minor changes, while Nonato emerges as a midfield option.

item.title: La pugna por la presidencia eclipsa el primer aniversario de una Suprema Corte que no encara sus grandes pendientes
item.description: The Supreme Court marks its first year amid reputational damage and unmet promises. Political disputes over the presidency and juridical missteps overshadow its agenda. Key issues such as taxation, preventive detention, and euthanasia remain unresolved.

item.title: Lula ainda não entendeu o trabalho da imprensa
item.description: President Lula was questioned about corruption scandals in his latest Jornal Nacional interview, reiterating that the press never apologized for Lava-Jato coverage. Journalist Renata Vasconcellos countered that Globo journalism fulfilled its duty to report the facts.

item.title: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro ou Augusto Cury: qual presidenciável foi melhor nas entrevistas da sabatina da TV Globo
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) received the highest average score (3.0) in the TV Globo interview, followed by Renan Santos (2.6) and Flávio Bolsonaro (2.4). Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury ranked lower, with decreasing scores. The ranking reflects the evaluation by GLOBO columnists on a scale from 1 to 5.

item.title: Corte e criação de ministérios, conflito de interesse e drone contra o feminicídio: a entrevista de Augusto Cury à Globo em cinco pontos
item.description: Augusto Cury proposes to cut ministries, create new ones, expand Bolsa Família benefits, tax bets, and use technology to reduce violence against women. He denies conflicts of interest and suggests hiring digital influencers in embassies.

item.title: Eleições nos estados e comando do Congresso: o que está por trás da reaproximação de Lula com Alcolumbre e Motta
item.description: Lula moves closer to Alcolumbre and Motta to pass key PECs like the end of the 6x1 scale and the 'blusinhas' tax, focusing on the 2026 electoral agenda. These agreements directly benefit the congressional leaders in their own campaigns, expanding government support for candidates tied to the lawmakers.

item.title: VÍDEO: Qual a diferença entre deputado estadual e federal?
item.description: The g1 video explains the difference between state and federal deputies, noting that federal deputies work at the Chamber of Deputies in Brasília on national issues, while state deputies operate in legislative assemblies with state-level jurisdiction. Both discuss and vote on bills and oversee the government, but their scope differs by office. The 50-video series also covers 2026 elections, campaign technologies, and voting guidance.

item.title: Eleições 2026: o que os planos de governo propõem para proteger crianças na internet
item.description: Presidential candidates in 2026 include proposals in their government plans to protect children and adolescents in the digital environment, addressing issues such as cyberbullying, sexual exploitation, hate speech and mental health. Measures range from digital platform regulation and critical thinking education to the creation of specific laws and pediatric and psychosocial monitoring.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro mente e distorce com mais convicção que o pai
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is accused of lying and distorting information more frequently and resolutely than his father, Jair Bolsonaro, representing a negative political evolution according to the article.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na entrevista de Augusto Cury à Globo
item.description: Candidate Augusto Cury was interviewed by Globo, where he made claims about digital betting revenues and taxation that were fact-checked as inaccurate. The Fato ou Fake team identified significant discrepancies in the figures cited and the tax rate mentioned.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a governador do Amapá (AP) nas eleições 2026
item.description: Five politicians are running for governor of Amapá in 2026: Clécio Luís (União Brasil) seeks re-election, while Dr. Furlan (MDB) leads the polls. Also running are Carlos Cley (PSTU), Delegado Marcos (DC), and Jairo Palheta (PCO).

item.title: Augusto Cury na Globo: o que disse o candidato à Presidência na entrevista à emissora
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, stated in an interview with TV Globo that he aims to combine the best of the right (market economy, lean state) and left (social welfare) in his platform. He proposed cuts in public spending, increased revenue through taxation on betting companies, and raising the minimum wage, while preserving the fiscal framework and opposing pension reform.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB rebate Flávio sobre ele apoiar Lula
item.description: Former FAB commander rebuts Flávio Bolsonaro's claim of Lula support. Carlos Baptista Junior states the senator used the accusation to avoid addressing the 2022 coup risk. The exchange occurs amid 2026 electoral debates.

item.title: Augusto Cury defende taxar as bets em 52%, mas evita detalhar corte de ministérios e ajuste fiscal
item.description: Augusto Cury proposes increasing taxation on betting companies to 52%, claiming it could generate an extra R$120 billion. He plans to cut between eight and ten ministries without specifying which ones and suggests a different rule for the minimum wage. Cury avoids discussing a new pension reform and recommends Ronaldo Caiado for a new Ministry of Public Security.

item.title: Comércio, serviço e turismo lançam campanha para adiar votação da PEC do fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The National Confederation of Commerce, Services and Tourism launched a campaign to delay the vote on the PEC that eliminates the 6x1 shift schedule in the Senate, arguing that the measure may worsen the economic crisis and affect jobs. The entity highlights the delicate moment of the Brazilian economy and calls for calm among senators.

item.title: Quaest no Pará: Lula lidera com 39% no 1º turno; Flávio Bolsonaro tem 28%
item.description: A new Quaest poll released on August 29, 2026, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading vote intention in Pará for the first round of elections with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 28%. The survey, conducted between August 25 and 28 with 804 voters, has a margin of error of three percentage points and a 95% confidence level. Other notable candidates include Augusto Cury (Avante) with 5%, and a significant share of undecided voters (15%).

item.title: Quaest: Helder Barbalho lidera ao Senado no Pará com 23%
item.description: Helder Barbalho (MDB) leads Senate vote intentions in Pará with 23%, followed by a technical tie between Éder Mauro (PL) and Zequinha Marinho (Podemos). In the gubernatorial race, Dr. Daniel (Podemos) and Hana Ghassan (MDB) tie in the first round with 28% and 27%, remaining tied in the second round. In the presidential race, Lula (PT) leads with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 28%.

item.title: Ex-chefe da FAB diz que fala de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre suposto apoio a Lula é 'leviandade'
item.description: The former commander of the Brazilian Air Force, Carlos de Almeida Baptista Jr., labeled as 'nonsense' the statement by Flávio Bolsonaro claiming he would supposedly campaign for Lula's re-election. The remark unfolds amid growing political polarization ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB rebate Flávio Bolsonaro e nega fazer campanha para Lula
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior refuted Flávio Bolsonaro's accusations that he is campaigning for Lula, calling them a way to evade responsibility over the coup d'état. He emphasized his testimony at the STF and his anti-coup book, asserting his actions are unrelated to Lula's campaign.

item.title: Candidato investigado acompanha Flávio Bolsonaro em barqueata em Angra
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) attended a campaign event in Angra dos Reis alongside Renato, a federal deputy candidate under police investigation. The appearance drew criticism for associating the lawmaker with investigated figures.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB chama de ‘leviandade’ fala de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre suposto apoio a Lula
item.description: Former Air Force Commander, Brigadier Carlos de Almeida Baptista Junior, called Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) statements about alleged military support for President Lula 'recklessness'. The reaction occurs amid the 2026 presidential election context, generating tension between the Armed Forces and the Bolsonaro political camp.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança jogo do Tesouraço
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched a game inspired by the 'Tesouraço' proposal to reduce government spending, announced on Gamer Day. The game lets users cut items portrayed as petista expenses, featuring characters based on Jair Bolsonaro, Alfredo Gaspar, and Flávio. He also emphasized support for the Brazilian gaming industry.

item.title: TRE-SP rejeita pedido do PT para remover posts de Tarcísio
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court rejected the PT's request to remove Tarcísio de Freitas' posts about the Barretos Bull Rodeo Festival. Haddad's campaign accused the governor of turning the event into a publicity stunt, but election judges deemed his presence legitimate.

item.title: Haddad: apoio de ex-secretários tucanos tem “carga simbólica muito grande”
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) emphasized the symbolic support of 24 former PSDB secretaries, highlighting democratic convergences between the parties. He criticized privatizations and Tarcísio's administration, reinforcing unity against the far-right.

item.title: Tralli e Renata entrevistam Augusto Cury, candidato a presidente pelo Avante
item.description: The Tralli and Renata program interviews Augusto Cury, candidate for president from Avante, between August 24 and 29, broadcast live by Globo platforms. The interviews cover the top six candidates in the Quaest poll released on August 14, including figures such as Lula, Romeu Zema, and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vai ao TSE por discurso de Flávio em Barretos
item.description: Lula's campaign filed lawsuits with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro over his speech at the Barretos rodeo, requesting the annulment of his ticket and ineligibility for alleged misuse of economic power and deepfake usage. The coalition also demands the removal of videos linking Lula to the word 'thief' and penalties for improper publications.

item.title: Ex-chefe da FAB chama de ‘leviandade’ fala de Flávio sobre apoio a Lula
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos de Almeida Junior rejected accusations from senator Flávio Bolsonaro that he had supported Lula's reelection, calling the statements 'levity'. The military officer claimed his words were distorted and that Flávio used the remark to avoid answering direct questions. The incident occurs amid growing tensions between government figures and opponents in the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Quaest no Pará: Lula, 37%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 29%
item.description: The Quaest poll in Pará shows Lula at 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 29% in the presidential race. Ineligible candidate Pablo Marçal appears with 2% when included. Lula's government approval is 47%, with 46% disapproval.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB rebate Flávio e diz não fazer campanha para Lula
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior denied Flávio Bolsonaro's claims that he supports Lula, calling the allegations 'frivolous'. The dispute involves testimonies about alleged anti-democratic acts during the Bolsonaro administration and mutual criticisms during the presidential campaign.

item.title: Fui o 1º a criticar a esquerda, diz Caiado em propaganda eleitoral
item.description: Caiado claims in electoral campaign that he was the first to criticize the left and never associated with criminals, reinforcing his opposition to the PT and denouncing previous governments' omission in fighting crime.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira rebate fala de Lula sobre garis: "Trabalho digno"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira criticized President Lula for describing garbage collectors as a 'very poor profession', emphasizing that their work is dignified and essential. Nikolas argued that all professions should be valued, especially those keeping the streets clean.

item.title: Lula e Flávio trocam farpas em primeiro programa eleitoral na TV
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro exchanged barbs in their first televised election program, with mutual criticisms and proposal presentations. Lula highlighted his trajectory and attacked Flávio over corruption allegations, while Flávio criticized Lula's management and appealed to female voters.

item.title: Qual é o horário do Jornal Nacional? Veja que horas começa a entrevista de Augusto Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) is the last candidate to be interviewed by TV Globo in the 2026 presidential election series. The live interview will air on Saturday, August 29, at 9:20 PM, following the start of Jornal Nacional at 8:55 PM. Notable candidates include Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, Zema, and others.

item.title: Renan Santos defende tecnologia para reduzir fila do SUS e nova reforma trabalhista
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from Missão to the Presidency, proposed during a campaign event in São Paulo the implementation of an electronic single medical record with AI in the SUS to reduce waiting lines and speed up care. He also advocated for a new labor reform targeting app and informal workers, with a contract model based on the sale of hours and reduced contributions to social security. His proposals aim to modernize the public sector and increase labor formalization.

item.title: Lula rebate Flávio sobre mudanças climáticas: "Amadorismo irresponsável"
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's approach to climate change, calling it 'irresponsible amateurism' to address global warming solely through basic sanitation. The president highlighted R$23 billion in sanitation investments but stressed that climate action requires broader, science-based measures. Flávio previously denied global warming in 2019.
